title: Zingeroni Japanese Char Grilled Chicken On Stone Plate
description: A spicy and shaggy Japanese dish featuring char-grilled chicken with marsala-wine in a high-protein-friendly format, served on a hot-stone plate.
instructions: Season chicken thighs with red pepper flakes, soy sauce, lemon juice, ground black pepper, and sesame oil.
Preheat a stone plate to high heat (around 275°C).
Place chicken on hot-stone plate and marinate for 10 minutes.
In a pan, sauté ginger slices with marsala wine until reduced by half.
Serve the char-grilled chicken with its marinade sauce over rice or noodles.
Optional: Garnish with scallions (green onions) and sesame seeds.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
